title: Finding to correction matrix for record 0025
readingRule: A finding is closed only where an instrument shows the change, not where prose describes it. F-1 is not closed and is not reported as closed.

findings.what: Five due, failing RabbitMQ cases were absorbed into the manual profile and openDefects was reported as 0.
findings.done: All five reproduced against the pinned fixture; every root cause lies outside the write scope of re-slice 0004 and one lies in RabbitMQ.Client. They are deliberately not inventoried, so the required category is red on them. The due-ness goes to the lead as record 0027.

findings.what: The two proof contracts of re-slice 0004 had no evidence at all.
findings.done: Both evidence targets now exist with clean-build, package-consumer, architecture and mutation, all five scenarios and all four required mutants. Per the lead disposition this is the product repository half; the central gates are replayed by the lead.

findings.what: The BUILD category had no result of its own; abstractions was counted in its place.
findings.done: BUILD executed and bound with command, exit code and platform. The Windows leg is named as not executed.

findings.what: No public API or package surface comparison existed; BeginTestScope was unrecorded.
findings.done: 33 assemblies, 27473 members before and 27488 after, 15 additions and zero removals, every addition on the test-driving surface. The messaging API is unchanged, which is the condition the lead attached. ActiveMqTestHarness.Clean is documented and bound by a spec.

findings.what: Six sabotage paths survived the policy validator.
findings.done: All six are rejected. Self-tests went from 41 to 53 and the rules match the switch and the shape, not one spelling.

findings.what: 133 transitive findings carried no dependency path.
findings.done: 187 findings, all with a route resolved from the restore graph, zero unresolved. The only high finding in a packable project is still MessagePack 3.1.6 in ViciOne.ServiceBus.MessagePack.

findings.what: The post-re-slice pack run had no instrument record.
findings.done: Pack recorded with command, exit code, 33 packages and their hashes, like every other category.

findings.what: The kill switch restart timeout was shortened and the no-weakening list did not disclose it.
findings.done: Documented at the call site under the lead condition: the five seconds were never a subject of the spec, and every asserted state transition is preserved. Both thresholds and the health wait budget are unchanged.

findings.what: Five cases were reclassified between records 0013 and 0017 without an append-only correction.
findings.done: The missing correction entry exists and points at both records.

gates.result: PASS ci-policy all invariants hold; 53 self-tests OK; six sabotage mutants rejected
exit 0, 0 errors, four target frameworks; Windows leg not executed locally and reported as such

FAIL required-category rabbitmq: 5 not executed case(s) the inventory does not name. dotnet test itself exits 0 and reports 301 of 301 green; the category is rejected because the five open F-1 cases have no classification. This is the intended state until record 0027 is answered.
Includes the two new specs that bind the changed Clean semantics.

summary.why: The required RabbitMQ category is red by design until the due-ness of the five F-1 cases is decided.

notCleared: MessagePack 3.1.6 / GHSA-hv8m-jj95-wg3x in ViciOne.ServiceBus.MessagePack. Per the lead disposition this does not block the slice and remains a mandatory follow-up order.
